detail.body:
Select the V4.1 builder from training arguments, prepare typed PP plans from ContextParallelBatch, preserve logical packed lengths and account for actual indexer producers. Include a runnable smoke recipe and explicit unsupported-mode validation.

Depends on #8226 and its prerequisites. Training-specific change: https://github.com/FDecaYed/Megatron-LM/commit/3d2dddc44b07789d3ad6ae286d705d630206999d. The final merge target is main after the dependencies land.

Validation on H100: CLI/config/builder selection, SBHD and packed THD, CP2, PP2/VPP2 with P2P overlap, full recompute with TE fused wgrad, 16K single-document CP2 sparse-loss training, and 8-GPU DP2/EP2/PP2/CP2 checkpoint save/resume all passed. Final latest-main regression: 27 tests passed plus combined 8-GPU train/eval. Small proxy models, not released-model convergence or production performance.

Refreshed stack validation includes 16K single-document CP2/r1 sparse-loss training and evaluation. In a controlled BF16 4K small-model H100 recipe, step time improved from about 280 ms to 229–230 ms (source implementation: 265–267 ms). This is a proxy measurement, not released-model or MXFP8/SM100 qualification.

+# V4.1 text training draft
+
+This composition uses main's HybridModel, MoE, distributed optimizer and packed CP
+path. Each logical block is `VE`: CSA2 attention followed by MoE. It does not
+include vision, DSpark, FP4 QAT or a Sinkhorn optimizer. The fused attention uses
+main's 512-dimensional KV path, with BF16 indexer H32/H64 and D128.
+
+A small GPU smoke configuration (requires the normal Megatron CI container,
+FlashMLA and cuDNN Frontend):
+
+```bash
+CUDA_DEVICE_MAX_CONNECTIONS=1 uv run python -m torch.distributed.run \
+  --nproc-per-node=1 pretrain_hybrid.py \
+  --dsv4-version v4.1 --hybrid-layer-pattern VEVEVE \
+  --num-layers 6 --hidden-size 256 --num-attention-heads 64 \
+  --multi-latent-attention --q-lora-rank 128 --v-head-dim 512 \
+  --qk-pos-emb-head-dim 64 --output-projection-groups 8 \
+  --output-projection-lora-rank 32 --qk-layernorm --normalization RMSNorm \
+  --csa-compress-ratios '[2,0,2,0,2,0]' --csa-window-size 128 \
+  --csa2-kv-source-layers 0 --csa2-index-source-layers 0 2 \
+  --dsa-indexer-n-heads 64 --dsa-indexer-head-dim 128 --dsa-indexer-topk 128 \
+  --no-dsa-indexer-rotate-activation --dsa-kernel-backend cudnn \
+  --dsa-indexer-loss-coeff 0.01 --enable-mhc-connections --mhc-single-pass \
+  --num-experts 8 --moe-router-topk 2 --moe-ffn-hidden-size 256 \
+  --moe-token-dispatcher-type alltoall --swiglu --disable-bias-linear \
+  --attention-dropout 0 --hidden-dropout 0 --bf16 \
+  --seq-length 1024 --max-position-embeddings 1024 \
+  --micro-batch-size 1 --global-batch-size 8 --train-iters 10 --lr 0.0001 \
+  --mock-data --tokenizer-type NullTokenizer --vocab-size 256 \
+  --eval-interval 1000 --eval-iters 1 --num-workers 0 \
+  --no-create-attention-mask-in-dataloader --untie-embeddings-and-output-weights
+```
+
+Source IDs and compression ratios above use **physical** V/E layer positions.
+`DeepSeekV41Config.from_hf()` converts the released logical block IDs to that
+representation. For the 40-block schedule, Full source IDs are `[4,16,28,40]`,
+index sources are `[4,16,28,40,48,56,64,72]`, and candidate source is `40`.
+The first two logical blocks use window-only attention, the next 18 use r2,
+and the final 20 use r1. Insert zero ratios at all E positions.
+
+Engram is enabled with `--engram-config options.json --engram-token-map map.pt`.
+The JSON contains the `EngramConfig` fields. Layer IDs here are **logical block
+IDs**. `map.pt` must contain the int64 tensor produced from the exact released
+tokenizer by `build_compressed_token_map`; an identity map is not a substitute.
+The table counts must match the released distinct-prime layout.
+
+For PP/VPP, insert `|` at explicit stage/chunk boundaries. The builder creates
+one typed pipeline control group per replica and reuses it for virtual chunks.
+Packed batches are staged before P2P; ordinary CP1 batches remain lazy. CP uses
+`--attention-cp-layout contiguous --linear-cp-layout contiguous` and an existing
+SFT packed loader or `--dataloader-inter-document-masking`. Dynamic hybrid-CP and
+the separate sequence-packing scheduler are not enabled in this draft.
+
+Full recomputation uses `--recompute-granularity full --recompute-method uniform
+--recompute-num-layers 1`. Selective mHC recomputation keeps main's existing
+interface. Graph capture is an explicit model API (`capture_layers`,
+`graph_slots`, `graph_backend`), not automatic CLI warmup. It excludes Engram
+layers and full-recompute profiles. Reserve a slot for every in-flight
+microbatch. Variable-token MoE execution remains eager; capture attention layers
+without Engram attached.
+
+Local checks use real CPU PyTorch/Gloo. HybridStack parity tests substitute CPU
+projections and RoPE storage for TE/CUDA, and compare eager, checkpoint and split
+PP outputs/parameter gradients. H100 qualification also covers real FlashMLA/cuDNN attention forward/backward,
+native/fused and CP gradient parity, Torch/TE state graphs, PP2/VPP2 overlap,
+DP2/EP2/PP2/CP2 training, fused mHC and full recomputation, plus checkpoint save/load.
+These runs use small proxy models and synthetic data, not released-model convergence
+or a production throughput qualification. Blackwell validation is left to CI.

+# Copyright (c) 2026 NVIDIA CORPORATION & AFFILIATES. All rights reserved.
+
+"""Prepare V4.1 typed-pipeline plans from main's ContextParallelBatch contract."""
+
+from dataclasses import replace
+from functools import partial
+
+from megatron.core.models.deepseek_v41.state import BatchShape
+from megatron.core.pipeline_parallel.pipeline_payload import (
+    PipelineDataIterator,
+    PipelinePayloadPlan,
+)
+from megatron.core.utils import get_attr_wrapped_model
+
+
+def normalize_v41_batch(cp_batch):
+    """Keep logical lengths distinct from storage padding for attention and Engram."""
+    batch = cp_batch.get_batch()
+    packed = cp_batch.get_packed_seq_params()
+    logical = batch.get('cu_seqlens')
+    if packed is not None and logical is not None:
+        packed = replace(
+            packed, cu_seqlens_q=logical.reshape(-1).int(), cu_seqlens_kv=logical.reshape(-1).int()
+        )
+        cp_batch.packed_seq_params_by_layout[cp_batch.boundary_layout] = packed
+    # Token padding is represented by packed logical/physical lengths. Dense masks
+    # are not needed, and are not silently substituted for the packed contract.
+    if batch.get('padding_mask') is not None:
+        if packed is None or logical is None:
+            raise ValueError('V4.1 padded batches require original logical sequence prefixes')
+        batch['padding_mask'] = None
+    return cp_batch
+
+
+def batch_shape(cp_batch, args):
+    """Derive the same capacity on data-owning and metadata-only PP stages."""
+    batch, packed = cp_batch.get_batch(), cp_batch.get_packed_seq_params()
+    data = next((batch.get(k) for k in ('tokens', 'labels') if batch.get(k) is not None), None)
+    if data is not None:
+        return BatchShape.from_batch(data, packed, args.context_parallel_size)
+    if packed is not None:
+        if (
+            not isinstance(packed.total_tokens, int)
+            or packed.total_tokens % args.context_parallel_size
+        ):
+            raise ValueError('Packed PP metadata must expose an aligned host token capacity')
+        return BatchShape(
+            packed.total_tokens // args.context_parallel_size,
+            1,
+            packed.max_seqlen_q,
+            packed.cu_seqlens_q.numel() - 1,
+            args.context_parallel_size,
+        )
+    return BatchShape(args.seq_length, args.micro_batch_size)
+
+
+def prepare_v41_pipeline_inputs(
+    iterator, model, num_microbatches, *, args, get_batch, forward_only=False
+):
+    """Stage variable shapes before P2P; keep fixed SBHD batches lazy."""
+    describe = get_attr_wrapped_model(model, 'pipeline_payload_spec')
+    vp_stage = get_attr_wrapped_model(model, 'vp_stage')
+    load = partial(get_batch, iterator, vp_stage)
+    if not (args.sft or args.dataloader_inter_document_masking):
+        incoming, outgoing = describe(BatchShape(args.seq_length, args.micro_batch_size))
+        return PipelineDataIterator(
+            load,
+            PipelinePayloadPlan((incoming,) * num_microbatches, (outgoing,) * num_microbatches),
+        )
+    batches, incoming, outgoing = [], [], []
+    for _ in range(num_microbatches):
+        batch = normalize_v41_batch(load())
+        recv, send = describe(batch_shape(batch, args))
+        batches.append(batch)
+        incoming.append(recv)
+        outgoing.append(send)
+    return PipelineDataIterator(batches, PipelinePayloadPlan(tuple(incoming), tuple(outgoing)))

+# Copyright (c) 2026 NVIDIA CORPORATION & AFFILIATES. All rights reserved.
+
+"""V4.1 configuration and builder using main's existing training lifecycle."""
+
+import json
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from typing import ClassVar
+
+import torch
+
+from megatron.core.models.deepseek_v41.config import EngramConfig
+from megatron.core.models.deepseek_v41.model import DeepSeekV41Model
+from megatron.core.pipeline_parallel.typed_p2p_communication import create_pipeline_control_group
+from megatron.core.pipeline_parallel.utils import is_pp_first_stage, is_pp_last_stage
+from megatron.training.models.hybrid import HybridModelBuilder, HybridModelConfig
+from megatron.training.vocab_utils import calculate_padded_vocab_size
+
+
+def configure_v41_args(args, kwargs):
+    """Validate the V/E schedule and read explicit conditional-memory configuration."""
+    pattern = (args.hybrid_layer_pattern or '').replace('|', '')
+    if pattern != 'VE' * (args.num_layers // 2):
+        raise ValueError('V4.1 requires a VE pair per logical block, with optional PP separators')
+    if args.hybrid_context_parallel or args.sequence_packing_scheduler is not None:
+        raise NotImplementedError(
+            'V4.1 entrypoint currently uses static CP and the packed dataloader'
+        )
+    if args.context_parallel_size > 1 and not (args.sft or args.dataloader_inter_document_masking):
+        raise ValueError('V4.1 CP requires SFT packing or --dataloader-inter-document-masking')
+    if args.create_attention_mask_in_dataloader:
+        raise ValueError('V4.1 requires --no-create-attention-mask-in-dataloader')
+    if args.experimental_attention_variant not in (None, 'dsv4_hybrid'):
+        raise ValueError('V4.1 requires experimental_attention_variant=dsv4_hybrid')
+    if args.spec is not None:
+        raise ValueError('V4.1 uses its explicit static model spec; omit --spec')
+    kwargs['experimental_attention_variant'] = 'dsv4_hybrid'
+    if args.engram_config is not None:
+        with open(args.engram_config, encoding='utf-8') as source:
+            kwargs['engram_config'] = EngramConfig(**json.load(source))
+        if args.engram_token_map is None:
+            raise ValueError('--engram-config requires --engram-token-map')
+
+
+@dataclass(kw_only=True)
+class DeepSeekV41ModelConfig(HybridModelConfig):
+    """Select the V4.1 builder; the transformer holds all architecture options."""
+
+    builder: ClassVar[str] = 'megatron.training.models.deepseek_v41.DeepSeekV41ModelBuilder'
+    engram_token_map: str | None = None
+
+
+class DeepSeekV41ModelBuilder(HybridModelBuilder):
+    """Reuse Hybrid's distributed wrapping, optimizer and checkpoint integration."""
+
+    def build_model(self, pg_collection, pre_process=None, post_process=None, vp_stage=None):
+        """Create one stage and reuse one typed-control group across its VPP chunks."""
+        c = self._model_config
+        if c.share_embeddings_and_output_weights:
+            raise ValueError('V4.1 requires --untie-embeddings-and-output-weights')
+        if not hasattr(self, '_pipeline_control_group'):
+            self._pipeline_control_group = (
+                create_pipeline_control_group(
+                    pg_collection.pp, world_group=torch.distributed.group.WORLD
+                )
+                if pg_collection.pp.size() > 1
+                else None
+            )
+        vocab = (
+            calculate_padded_vocab_size(
+                c.vocab_size,
+                c.make_vocab_size_divisible_by,
+                c.transformer.tensor_model_parallel_size,
+            )
+            if c.should_pad_vocab
+            else c.vocab_size
+        )
+        token_map = (
+            torch.load(c.engram_token_map, map_location='cpu', weights_only=True)
+            if c.engram_token_map is not None
+            else None
+        )
+        return DeepSeekV41Model(
+            config=c.transformer,
+            vocab_size=vocab,
+            max_sequence_length=c.seq_length,
+            hybrid_layer_pattern=c.hybrid_layer_pattern or c.transformer.hybrid_pattern,
+            token_map=token_map,
+            pre_process=is_pp_first_stage(pg_collection.pp) if pre_process is None else pre_process,
+            post_process=(
+                is_pp_last_stage(pg_collection.pp) if post_process is None else post_process
+            ),
+            parallel_output=c.parallel_output,
+            fp16_lm_cross_entropy=c.fp16_lm_cross_entropy,
+            logit_dtype=c.logit_dtype,
+            pg_collection=pg_collection,
+            vp_stage=vp_stage,
+            pipeline_control_group=self._pipeline_control_group,
+        )
+
+
+def estimate_v41_training_flops(args, total_tokens, squared_lengths):
+    """Matmul FLOP estimate using actual owners; excludes routing, norms and recompute.
+
+    Sparse support uses the configured window/Top-K upper bound. Causal full
+    indexing uses sum(L^2)/2; Reindex is capped by its candidate pool. This is a
+    reporting estimate, not executed-kernel work or a throughput measurement.
+    """
+    t, h, d, heads = total_tokens, args.hidden_size, args.v_head_dim, args.num_attention_heads
+    qrank, groups, orank = (
+        args.q_lora_rank,
+        args.output_projection_groups,
+        args.output_projection_lora_rank,
+    )
+    n = args.mhc_num_residual_streams
+    forward = 0
+    index_work = 0
+    for layer in range(0, args.num_layers, 2):
+        ratio = args.csa_compress_ratios[layer]
+        forward += (
+            2 * t * (h * qrank + qrank * heads * d + h * d + heads * d * orank + groups * orank * h)
+        )
+        forward += (
+            4 * t * heads * d * (args.csa_window_size + (args.dsa_indexer_topk if ratio else 0))
+        )
+        if layer in args.csa2_kv_source_layers:
+            forward += 2 * t * h * d * (2 if ratio == 2 else 1)
+            index_work += (
+                2
+                * t
+                / ratio
+                * d
+                * args.dsa_indexer_head_dim
+                * (3 if args.dsa_indexer_loss_coeff else 1)
+            )
+        if layer in args.csa2_index_source_layers:
+            index_work += (
+                2
+                * t
+                * args.dsa_indexer_n_heads
+                * (qrank * args.dsa_indexer_head_dim + h)
+                * (3 if args.dsa_indexer_loss_coeff else 1)
+            )
+            pairs = squared_lengths / (2 * ratio)
+            source = args.csa2_candidate_source_layer
+            if source is not None and layer > source:
+                pairs = min(
+                    pairs, t * args.csa2_candidate_topk_blocks * args.csa2_candidate_block_size
+                )
+            index_work += 2 * pairs * args.dsa_indexer_n_heads * args.dsa_indexer_head_dim
+            if args.dsa_indexer_loss_coeff:
+                supervised = (
+                    min(pairs, t * args.dsa_indexer_topk)
+                    if args.dsa_indexer_use_sparse_loss
+                    else pairs
+                )
+                index_work += 6 * supervised * args.dsa_indexer_n_heads * args.dsa_indexer_head_dim
+                index_work += 2 * supervised * heads * d
+    experts = args.moe_ffn_hidden_size * args.moe_router_topk + (
+        args.moe_shared_expert_intermediate_size or 0
+    )
+    forward += (args.num_layers // 2) * 6 * t * h * experts
+    forward += args.num_layers * 2 * t * (n * h * (n * n + 2 * n) + n * n * h + n * h)
+    # The args namespace keeps a path; the embedded transformer carries the dataclass.
+    options = args.engram_config
+    if isinstance(options, str):
+        with open(options, encoding='utf-8') as source:
+            options = EngramConfig(**json.load(source))
+    if options is not None:
+        width = (options.max_ngram_size - 1) * options.n_heads * options.head_dim
+        forward += len(options.layer_ids) * 2 * t * width * (n + 1) * h
+    forward += 2 * t * h * args.padded_vocab_size
+    return int(3 * forward + index_work)

+# Copyright (c) 2026 NVIDIA CORPORATION & AFFILIATES. All rights reserved.
+
+"""Packed metadata-only stages must plan the same buffers as data-owning stages."""
+
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+import torch
+
+from megatron.core.context_parallel import ContextParallelBatch
+from megatron.core.packed_seq_params import PackedSeqParams
+from megatron.training.datasets.v41_pipeline import (
+    batch_shape,
+    normalize_v41_batch,
+    prepare_v41_pipeline_inputs,
+)
+
+
+def test_packed_plans_preserve_logical_lengths_and_consume_batches_once():
+    logical = torch.tensor([0, 5, 11], dtype=torch.int32)
+    padded = torch.tensor([0, 8, 16], dtype=torch.int32)
+    params = PackedSeqParams(
+        qkv_format='thd',
+        cu_seqlens_q=padded,
+        cu_seqlens_kv=padded,
+        cu_seqlens_q_padded=padded,
+        cu_seqlens_kv_padded=padded,
+        max_seqlen_q=8,
+        max_seqlen_kv=8,
+        total_tokens=16,
+    )
+    args = SimpleNamespace(
+        context_parallel_size=2, sft=True, dataloader_inter_document_masking=False
+    )
+    batches = []
+    for owns_data in (True, False):
+        batch = ContextParallelBatch.from_single_layout(
+            'contiguous',
+            dict(
+                cu_seqlens=logical, tokens=torch.ones(1, 8, dtype=torch.long) if owns_data else None
+            ),
+            params,
+        )
+        batches.append(normalize_v41_batch(batch))
+    assert batch_shape(batches[0], args) == batch_shape(batches[1], args)
+    assert torch.equal(batches[0].get_packed_seq_params().cu_seqlens_q, logical)
+    model = SimpleNamespace(vp_stage=0, pipeline_payload_spec=lambda shape: (shape, shape))
+    reads = []
+
+    def get_batch(iterator, stage):
+        reads.append(stage)
+        return next(iterator)
+
+    prepared = prepare_v41_pipeline_inputs(iter(batches), model, 2, args=args, get_batch=get_batch)
+    assert reads == [0, 0]
+    assert prepared.pipeline_payload_plan.incoming[0] == prepared.pipeline_payload_plan.incoming[1]
+    assert list(prepared) == batches
+    assert reads == [0, 0]
